title: People’s Mañanera November 4
author: Pedro Gellert
content:
_Every day, President Claudia Sheinbaum gives a morning presidential press
conference and Mexico Solidarity Media posts English language summaries,
translated by Mexico Solidarity 's Pedro Gellert. Previous press conference
summaries are available [here](https://mexicosolidarity.com/mananera/)._

**Michoacán Plan: Well-being to Advance Toward Peace  
** One year in, the plan is 67% complete, with an investment of over 72.43
billion pesos (US$3.9 billion). “We must continue working to move forward and
achieve peace and security,” said President Claudia Sheinbaum.

**Michoacán: Decent Healthcare and Housing for the People  
** The Mexican Social Security Institute (IMSS) administered 2.5 million
vaccines, provided 502,000 medical consultations, and is building two
hospitals. The Institute for Social Security and Services for State Workers
(ISSSTE) has added 33 new clinics to its total and is carrying out
construction projects involving an investment of over 1.13 billion pesos
(US$61.02 million). With nearly 12 billion pesos (US$650 million), the
“Housing for Well-being” program is making progress toward its goal of 82,000
homes to guarantee recipients the right to a home of their own.

**U.S. Elections: Mexican Pride and the Link to Sovereignty  
** The President highlighted the victories of Xavier Becerra in California and
Gina Hinojosa in Texas, citing their ties to Mexico and Mexican-American
participation in the elections. The result “reflects the sentiment of the
American people,” Sheinbaum stated.

**INE: From the Pact for Mexico to Contract Duopoly  
** “What moral authority does Ugalde have to speak of democracy? None,”
Sheinbaum declared, in reference to the former president of the National
Electoral Institute (INE). She held him responsible for the 2006 electoral
fraud and questioned why its former president Lorenzo Córdova did not put a
stop to the duopoly at the INE. She criticized the 2014 reform, stemming from
the Pact for Mexico, for concentrating the appointment of state election
council board members within the INE. The President called on the Federal
Superior Audit Department (ASF) to investigate contracts dating back to before
2023 and to clarify who had favored those companies for more than 20 years.
